title: Execution observations stop after a run's named root moves, so done refuses unconfirmed_declaration on a clean evaluated commit
outcome: After a session's named root moves to a new worktree or commit, the host keeps delivering that run's source observations for the new root, so a clean evaluated commit can be completed.
acceptance: The cause is identified from host records and source: why observations for the run stopped at the old root and nothing was recorded for the new one.
After a root move within one run, observations for the new root are delivered on later turns, shown by a behaviour test that fails before the fix and passes after.
Engram child item 778f's case, or an equivalent live case, completes with done on its clean evaluated commit without re-running the evaluation.
